description: This file defines a custom RepaintManager class, ThreadCheckingRepaintManager, which performs thread safety checks when GUI components are updated. It includes methods for verifying thread context, dumping component trees, and is intended for use in Swing-based Java applications to detect improper GUI updates from non-Event Dispatch Thread.

classes.name: ThreadCheckingRepaintManager
classes.description: A custom RepaintManager subclass that checks for thread-safe GUI updates and optionally ensures components are showing before performing checks.

methods.name: ThreadCheckingRepaintManager
methods.description: Constructor that sets whether to check if components are showing.

methods.name: addInvalidComponent
methods.description: Overrides RepaintManager method to add invalid components and perform thread checks.

methods.name: checkThread
methods.description: Checks if the current thread is the Event Dispatch Thread and logs a warning with component tree if not.

methods.name: getStracktraceAsString
methods.description: Converts an exception's stack trace into a string.

methods.name: checkIsShowing
methods.description: Determines if the component is showing based on internal flag.

methods.name: addDirtyRegion
methods.description: Overrides method to check thread before marking a region dirty for repaint.

methods.name: dumpComponentTree
methods.description: Outputs the hierarchy of components, indicating their visibility and showing status.

methods.name: resetTabCount
methods.description: Resets indentation level for component tree dump.

methods.name: incrementTabCount
methods.description: Increments indentation level for component tree dump.

methods.name: printTabIndent
methods.description: Prints indentation corresponding to current depth in component tree.
